How Do I Format Telegram Posts? (Bold, Italic, Links, Spoilers and Buttons)
Formatting is what separates a channel that looks professional from one that looks like a group chat. Fast Scheduler keeps every bit of it intact between scheduling and publishing.
Rich text survives the whole pipeline
Write a message anywhere — bold headlines, italic asides,
underlined
warnings,
struck-through
corrections, monospace code — and schedule it. Formatting is stored as Telegram
entities
, not flat text, so what publishes is pixel-identical to what you wrote: no mangled asterisks, no lost links, no broken emoji.
Spoilers

Wrap part of the text in spoiler markup and it publishes as a real Telegram spoiler — blurred until a reader taps it. Perfect for giveaways, answers, and sensitive details. The bot validates spoiler markup while you type, so unclosed pairs are caught at scheduling time, not in front of your audience.
Inline URL buttons
Add tappable buttons to any post with one syntax:
[Button Text](https://example.com)

. Use them for call-to-action links — “Read the guide”, “Buy now”, “Join the chat”. Buttons attach to text posts and to media posts alike. Keep button labels short (two or three words read best) and test one post before scheduling a whole campaign.
Custom emoji
Premium Telegram emoji in your drafts are preserved on publish, so your brand’s custom smileys do not degrade into defaults.
Signatures: formatting that stamps itself
Configure a
signature

once — a footer with your links, hashtags or contact — and every scheduled post carries it automatically, on text and media alike. Signatures keep their own formatting, and you can override the signature per post when a particular message should go out clean.
A checklist for polished posts
One bold hook line first — most readers see only it in notifications.
Links as buttons where possible; they out-click inline links.
Spoilers for anything the reader should opt into.
A signature so every post quietly advertises your next channel.
Common questions
Does Telegram formatting survive scheduling in Fast Scheduler?
Yes. Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, links, spoilers and custom emoji are stored as Telegram entities and publish exactly as written.
How do I add buttons to a scheduled Telegram post?
Use the syntax [Button Text](https://your-link.com) in the message. The bot converts it into a tappable inline URL button on the published post.
Inline Buttons
Can every scheduled post have an automatic signature?
Yes. Create a signature once and it is appended to every scheduled and recurring post automatically, keeping its own formatting. Individual posts can override it.
